newsitem.title: UK: Rank shares drop despite FT comment.
newsitem.headline: Rank shares drop despite FT comment.

text.p: Shares in Rank Group Plc were among the biggest decliners in the FTSE 100 in early trading on Friday, despite relatively upbeat comment on the stock in the influential Financial Times Lex column.
The stock was down 8-1/2p or two percent at 416 by 0842 GMT, outpacing the 1.1 percent drop in the FTSE 100 index following the latest shake-out on Wall Street.

Rank shares have underperformed the FTSE in recent months yet the FT said next week's trading statement from the leisure group should show a pickup in the momentum of the company's restructuring programme under chief executive Andrew Teare.
Most analysts were optimistic about the trading update, due on December 19.

"I think it will be favourable," said UBS analyst Julian Easthope. "The indications are that Rank is doing fairly well." He said the film division should see the effects of recent big blockbusters movie releases.
Another analyst, who did not wish to be named, said he was surprised by the slide as he had expected the stock to improve ahead of the trading statement.
